summary: Formalize the Pantheon <-> Lovable closed loop and expand Pantheon Console into an 8-workbench planning backlog.
objective: Define the canonical closed-loop coordination protocol, GitHub dispatch model, screen-packet requirements, and execution backlog for all 8 Pantheon Console workbenches.
brief_files: Pantheon_總索引版系統分析文件.md

lane_focus.Claude: Facilitate the Pantheon Console loop session, integrate cited disagreements, and finalize the consensus packet once loop mechanics and workbench backlog converge.
lane_focus.Codex: Own the shared starter draft, verify .coordination, mirroring, supervisor, and task materialization mechanics, and draft the execution slice DAG.
lane_focus.Gemini: Evaluate supervisor, runtime, GitHub dispatch, replay, and failure-mode feasibility for the closed-loop automation path.
lane_focus.Qwen: Audit canonical object boundaries, BFF and contract truth, and screen-to-contract alignment for APP-002 slices and workbench backlog claims.
lane_focus.Copilot: Pressure-test front-end packet shape, Lovable usability, screen inventory completeness, and information architecture coverage across all 8 workbenches.

Gemini.summary: Gemini planning lane may be waived on quota or capacity failure. Codex and Claude must absorb runtime and GitHub dispatch coverage if this occurs.

Copilot.summary: Copilot planning lane may be waived on quota or capacity failure. Codex and Claude must absorb front-end IA and Lovable packet critique if this occurs.

cross_review_rounds.summary: All lane readouts are submitted or waived; start cited cross-review on the coordination loop spec and 8-workbench backlog.

unresolved_items.summary: Local sibling checkout ../front-ai-trading-system is missing. LOOP-003 owns repo bootstrap and mirror validation before any live Lovable cycle.
Pantheon currently has .coordination mirroring and GitHub issue bus scaffolding, but no repository_dispatch or workflow_dispatch closed-loop workflows yet. LOOP-002 owns workflow bootstrap.
Gemini planning lane waived after 2026-04-14T05:39:45Z capacity/rate-limit failure; Codex and Claude absorb runtime and GitHub dispatch feasibility coverage for this session.
Copilot planning lane waived after 2026-04-14T05:39:47Z quota failure (402 You have no quota); Codex and Claude absorb front-end IA and Lovable packet critique for this session.

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Expand the .coordination protocol for the Pantheon-Lovable closed loop
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 擴充 .coordination protocol，正式定義 lovable-ui-task、frontend-feedback、backend-delivery 與回放語意。
acceptance: lovable-ui-task keeps backward compatibility while adding workbench, screen_id, ui_spec_path, frontend_change_spec_path, required_feedback, and delivery_dependencies
frontend-feedback and backend-delivery payloads are defined as canonical .coordination types
mirror paths, feedback bundle paths, and failure or replay semantics are locked in the spec

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Add GitHub dispatch workflows for Pantheon closed-loop coordination
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 為 Pantheon 與前端 repo 補 repository_dispatch 與 workflow_dispatch workflow，形成正式的 closed-loop automation。
acceptance: Pantheon receiver and manual replay workflow specs are defined
front repo handoff receiver and feedback publisher workflow specs are defined
dispatch event names, client_payload contract, and replay path are testable without depending on the old GitHub issue bus

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Bootstrap the front repo prerequisites for the Pantheon-Lovable loop
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 補 front repo sibling checkout、label bootstrap、mirror validation 與 workflow 先決條件。
acceptance: ../front-ai-trading-system prerequisite is recorded as a hard requirement
pantheon-bus and coordination-bus label bootstrap is specified
mirror validation checklist exists for handoff bundle, request templates, and feedback bundle paths

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Packetize Governance and Deployment Review screens from existing APP-002 slices
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 把 Promotion Review 與 Deployment Review 相關 operator screens 整理成正式 Lovable packet set。
acceptance: F-042 is reframed as one Governance Workbench screen instead of the whole admin surface
deployment review and governance queue follow-up screens receive canonical packet requirements
required example payloads and screen-spec gaps are explicitly listed

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Packetize Incident Response and Incident Control screens
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 把 Incident Response 與 control rail 整理成可 handoff 的 Lovable packet set。
acceptance: incident response read and control surfaces share one packet family with explicit degraded-state and fallback rules
command receipts, action gating, and secondary control path copy are mapped to packet fields
screen inventory distinguishes incident home, detail, and action drawer responsibilities

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Packetize Post-Incident and Evolution screens
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 把 Post-Incident Review 與 Evolution 相關 screens 整理成正式 packet set。
acceptance: post-incident review, evolution review, lineage evidence, and telemetry evidence are mapped to packet-ready screens
EVO-004 dependency remains explicit where execute boundaries are still unresolved
the packet set distinguishes read-only evidence panels from future actionable mutation review panels

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Packetize Persona Management and Remaining Catalog drilldowns
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 把 Persona Management 與 remaining catalog drilldowns 整理成 Persona Workbench packet set。
acceptance: persona management is promoted from a sidecar handoff into a canonical screen packet
remaining catalog endpoints are grouped into explicit drilldown modules instead of a vague catch-all
Lovable readiness and missing screen-spec work are listed per module

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Packetize the global degradation banner and SSE/live reconciliation slice
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 把全域 degradation banner 與 SSE/live reconciliation slice 整理成正式 packet 與 integration plan。
acceptance: global degradation banner rules are defined once and referenced by all operator-facing packets
SSE, reconnect, replay, and stale-state reconciliation are described as a frontend integration slice rather than pure visual work
screen packets call out where live state is required and where polling fallback is acceptable

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Operator Console backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Operator Console 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: dashboard, alerts, health, runtime state, paper-live drift, deployment review, incident response, and post-incident coverage are all listed
each module records existing Pantheon support, missing canonical screen specs, Lovable readiness, and backend dependencies
the recommended execution wave is explicit for every operator module

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Persona Workbench backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Persona Workbench 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: personas, persona detail, tool profile, consult policy, and capital pool binding are all mapped to explicit modules
existing persona-management and remaining catalog support is linked to the correct screens
missing BFF or contract dependencies are separated from missing screen-spec work

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Research Workbench backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Research Workbench 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: search, analyze, research ticket, experiment launch, and artifact compare are all listed as separate planning modules
current directionally-correct front-end work is acknowledged without treating it as packet-ready
backend gaps and packetization prerequisites are called out for each research module

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Knowledge Workbench backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Knowledge Workbench 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: insight cards, strategy spec, evidence refs, research notes, and institutional memory are all captured as modules
the backlog separates knowledge-specific BFF needs from screen-spec needs
recommended waves avoid bundling Knowledge Workbench into unrelated operator packetization work

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Trainer Workbench backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Trainer Workbench 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: teaching dialog, parameter controls, before-after compare, and replay modules are all listed
demo-grade current state is explicitly distinguished from packet-ready scope
backend and contract requirements are documented before Lovable is invited to change Trainer flows

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Consultation Workbench backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Consultation Workbench 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: consult request, committee board, debate transcript, and red-team memo are all mapped to planning modules
missing backend orchestration dependencies are surfaced explicitly
the backlog states that Consultation Workbench is not yet packet-ready and needs canonical screen specs first

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Governance Workbench backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Governance Workbench 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: review queue, approval queue, promotion review, deployment diff, rollback review, and governance audit rail are all listed
F-042 is explicitly categorized as one screen inside Governance Workbench, not as the whole workbench
remaining governance screens receive wave recommendations and packetization prerequisites

proposed_execution_tasks.title: Define the Evolution Workbench backlog and wave plan
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 整理 Evolution Workbench 的 screen inventory、現況支撐、缺規格與推薦執行波次。
acceptance: post-incident review, evolution center, lineage, inspiration graph, and mutation review are all mapped to modules
existing Pantheon support from APP-002 sidecars is linked to the correct evolution modules
live-state and evidence dependencies are called out before Lovable packetization is attempted
